verdicts.evidence: The sentence "The reading room reopens on Monday with new lamps, new shelves, and a table set aside for jigsaw puzzles" sits last on the page in small, light grey regular type under the large quote and the bold attribution, so "Monday" is easy to miss (the kicker is slightly smaller, but this sentence is still the faintest).
The large serif headline uses straight double quotes at both ends, straight single quotes around 'old', a straight apostrophe in It's, and a spaced hyphen in "room - nobody".
